title: Soupy Rice Mixture with Chicken and Potatoes, Puerto Rican Style

content.title: About
content.content: Soupy rice mixture with chicken and potatoes, Puerto Rican style is a ready‑to‑cook dry blend that includes rice, dehydrated chicken breast, potato pieces and traditional spices (adobo, oregano, cumin). When rehydrated with water and simmered, it turns into a fragrant, hearty soup typical of Puerto Rican cuisine.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The dish is based on the classic Puerto Rican "arroz con pollo" where rice is cooked together with chicken and root vegetables.
The blend contains aromatic spices characteristic of Caribbean cooking, such as adobo and cumin.
Dry ingredients allow the product to be stored for up to 12 months without loss of flavor.
Original recipes often include bell pepper and onion, which are replaced by dried flavorings in the mix.
The meal is popular with travelers because it is quick to prepare and requires no fresh produce.

items.title: Protein source
items.content: Dehydrated chicken provides high‑quality animal protein essential for tissue repair.

items.title: Complex carbohydrates
items.content: Rice supplies slowly digestible carbs that help maintain steady energy levels.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Spices and chicken contain B1, B3 and B6 vitamins important for metabolism.

items.title: Potassium
items.content: The potato component is rich in potassium, supporting heart and muscle function.

items.title: Low fat content
items.content: The blend contains minimal added fats, making it suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Chicken allergy
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to chicken protein; caution is advised.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Dry mixes are often salted for flavor; people limiting sodium should monitor portion size.

items.title: Gluten
items.content: Certain versions may contain gluten‑based flavorings; check the label if you have celiac disease.

items.title: Adequate water needed
items.content: Insufficient liquid can result in a overly thick or dry dish.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Bring 300 ml of water to a boil in a pot, add the packet contents, stir and simmer for 12‑15 minutes until the rice and potatoes are tender. For extra freshness you can stir in chopped vegetables, a squeeze of lime or cilantro.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the dry mix in an airtight container in a cool, dry place away from moisture and direct sunlight. Once opened, use within 6 months.
